sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In Traders Trading, the core gameplay mechanics are centered around making deals with your opponent. The game takes place on a table, where you and your opponent take turns throwing toys onto the table. The goal is to make the most profitable deals possible, while also trying to sabotage your opponent's chances of success. The game features a variety of toys, each with its own unique value and properties. Some toys are worth more than others, and some may have special abilities that can help or hinder your progress.

One of the key aspects of Traders Trading is the concept of 'trading'. When you throw a toy onto the table, you can choose to trade it with your opponent for a different toy. This can be a high-risk, high-reward strategy, as you may end up with a better toy, but you may also end up with a worse one. The game also features a 'discard' option, which allows you to get rid of a toy that you don't want. This can be a great way to get rid of a toy that's not worth much, but it can also leave you with a hole in your collection.

The game also features a 'timer' that limits the amount of time you have to make a deal. This adds an element of pressure to the game, as you must make quick decisions and act fast in order to succeed. The timer also adds a level of unpredictability to the game, as you never know when it will run out and the game will end. Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Traders Trading are simple yet addictive, making it a great fit for players of all ages and skill levels.
